title: What the Primary Lund Plane Omits: A Model-Stitching Diagnosis of a Jet-Tagger Representation Gap
abstract: arXiv:2610.37137v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Lund-plane and Particle Transformer (ParT) jet taggers can differ in performance because one representation is weaker, or because a weaker downstream computation reads an adequate one. Standalone performance cannot separate these. Model stitching can: it links the frozen early layers of one network to the frozen late layers of another through a single trained linear map. As a positive control we use an incomplete Lund representation, the primary declustering branch, whose deficit is known independently. Stitched into ParT's downstream, it reaches a background rejection at least as much as its own downstream recovers, yet far below ParT's background rejection: the deficit is representational, not computational. A hypergraph reader over splitting triplets does no better, ruling out higher-order correlations as the cause. The gap is invisible in AUC, which stays within 1\% of its target value, and appears only in background rejection at l

translated_title: 主Lund平面遗漏了什么：喷注标记器表征差距的模型拼接诊断
translated_abstract: Lund平面与粒子Transformer（ParT）喷注标记器在性能上可能存在差异，这既可能是因为其中一种表征较弱，也可能是因为一个较弱的下游计算读取了一个本已足够的表征。仅凭独立性能无法区分这两种情况，而模型拼接可以做到：它通过一个经过训练的线性映射，将一个网络的冻结早期层与另一个网络的冻结晚期层连接起来。作为阳性对照，我们使用一个不完整的Lund表征——主分解支路——其缺陷可被独立地确认。将其拼接到ParT的下游后，其本底排除率至少能达到其自身下游所能恢复的水平，却远低于ParT的本底排除率：这表明该缺陷是表征性的，而非计算性的。基于分裂三元组的超图读取器表现也并无改善，从而排除了高阶相关性作为成因的可能。该差距在AUC中不可见（AUC保持在目标值的1%以内），仅在本底排除率上显现。
tldr: 本文利用模型拼接技术诊断喷注标记器的表征差距，证明主Lund平面（仅含主分解支路）相对ParT的性能缺陷源于表征信息缺失而非下游计算能力不足，且高阶相关性也被排除为成因。
en_tdlr: Using model stitching, this paper diagnoses that the primary Lund plane's performance gap relative to ParT in jet tagging is representational rather than computational, with higher-order correlations ruled out as the cause.
